name: Cinemersive Video Player
summary:
Cinemersive Labs brings the next generation of fully immersive, three-dimensional videos to standalone VR headsets. Our technology allows to acquire, process, store, and render videos in six degrees-of-freedom 3D.

The current version of the app contains 17 6DoF videos.
Ten of these have been converted from regular 2D smartphone videos using the latest generation of Cinemersive video conversion engine. The remaining seven were acquired with a compact five-camera rig.
